bootstrap.default:
# zsh mod
zmodload zsh/zprof
zmodload zsh/mathfunc 

# disable zsh history expansion triggered by "!" character
setopt no_bang_hist

# hide history with space
setopt HIST_IGNORE_SPACE

# initialize zsh completion engine and bash-compatibility bridge
autoload -Uz compinit
if [ "$(date +'%j')" != "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%j' ~/.zcompdump 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    compinit
else
    compinit -C
fi
autoload -Uz bashcompinit && bashcompinit

# zsh case insensitive completion
zstyle ':completion:*' matcher-list '' 'm:{a-zA-Z}={A-Za-z}' 'r:|[._-]=* r:|=*' 'l:|=* r:|=*'

# Enable bracketed paste magic to handle long text safely, speed up paste
autoload -Uz bracketed-paste-magic
zle -N bracketed-paste bracketed-paste-magic

install.ubuntu:
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "uv is already installed"
  if [ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    log "[dry-run] uv self update"
  else
    uv self update
  fi
else
  if [ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    log "[dry-run] install uv via curl"
  else
    curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
  fi
fi

install.macos:
brew-install gnupg
brew-install pinentry
mkdir -p "$HOME/.gnupg"
chmod 700 "$HOME/.gnupg"
if command -v pinentry-mac >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! grep -q 'pinentry-program' "$HOME/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf"; then
  printf 'pinentry-program %s\n' "$(command -v pinentry-mac)" > "$HOME/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf"
fi
install.ubuntu:
apt-install pinentry-curses
apt-install pinentry-tty
gpgconf --kill gpg-agent
mkdir -p "$HOME/.gnupg"
chmod 700 "$HOME/.gnupg"
if command -v pinentry-curses >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! grep -q 'pinentry-program' "$HOME/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf"; then
  printf 'pinentry-program %s\n' "$(command -v pinentry-curses)" > "$HOME/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf"
fi
gpgconf --kill gpg-agent
gpg-connect-agent updatestartuptty /bye

bootstrap.default: export MANPAGER="sh -c 'col -bx | bat -l man -p'" export BAT_THEME="Catppuccin Macchiato" alias cat="bat --paging=never --plain" alias less="bat -p"

function y() {
  local tmp="$(mktemp -t "yazi-cwd.XXXXXX")" cwd
  yazi "$@" --cwd-file="$tmp"
  if cwd="$(command cat -- "$tmp")" && [ -n "$cwd" ] && [ "$cwd" != "$PWD" ]; then
    builtin cd -- "$cwd"
  fi
  rm -f -- "$tmp"
}

export BMA_HOME="${HOME}/opt/bash-my-aws"
export PATH="$PATH:${BMA_HOME}/bin"
export BMA_COLUMNISE_ONLY_WHEN_TERMINAL_PRESENT=true
source ${BMA_HOME}/aliases
source ${BMA_HOME}/bash_completion.sh
